project_name: Erdős 918: shift graphs and local chromatic equality

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.iteratedTwoPow
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos918.iteratedTwoPow.{u} (r : Nat) (μ : Cardinal) : Cardinal :=
  fun r μ => Nat.rec μ (fun x c => HPow.hPow 2 c) r

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.ShiftStep
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos918.ShiftStep.{u} (r : Nat) {α : Type u} [Preorder α] (u v : Erdos918.ShiftTuple r α) : Prop :=
  fun r {α} [Preorder α] u v =>
  And (LT.lt (Subtype.val u 0) (Subtype.val v 0))
    (∀ (i : Fin r), Eq (Subtype.val u (Fin.succ i)) (Subtype.val v (Fin.castSucc i)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.ShiftGraph
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos918.ShiftGraph.{u} (r : Nat) (α : Type u) [Preorder α] : SimpleGraph (Erdos918.ShiftTuple r α) :=
  fun r α [Preorder α] =>
  SimpleGraph.mk (fun u v => Or (Erdos918.ShiftStep r u v) (Erdos918.ShiftStep r v u))
    (Erdos918.ShiftGraph._proof_2 r α) (Erdos918.ShiftGraph._proof_3 r α)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.ShiftTuple
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos918.ShiftTuple.{u} (r : Nat) (α : Type u) [Preorder α] : Type u :=
  fun r α [Preorder α] => Subtype fun x => StrictMono x

core_notation_audit.name: SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal.{u} {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Cardinal :=
  fun {V} G => InfSet.sInf (Set.ofPred fun κ => Exists fun C => Exists fun x => Nonempty (SimpleGraph.Coloring G C))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.variants.erdos_hajnal
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos918.variants.erdos_hajnal.{u}
  (hGCH : ∀ (c : Cardinal), LE.le Cardinal.aleph0 c → Eq (HPow.hPow 2 c) (Order.succ c)) (k : Nat) (hk : LT.lt 0 k) :
  Exists fun V =>
    Exists fun G =>
      And (Eq (Cardinal.mk V) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph ↑k))
        (And (Eq (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal G) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph 1))
          (∀ (W : Set V),
            LT.lt (Cardinal.mk (Set.Elem W)) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph ↑k) →
              LE.le (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal (SimpleGraph.induce W G)) Cardinal.aleph0))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.variants.eq_aleph_0.parts.i
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos918.variants.eq_aleph_0.parts.i.{u} :
  Not
    (Exists fun V =>
      Exists fun G =>
        And (Eq (Cardinal.mk V) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph 2))
          (And (Eq (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal G) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph 2))
            (∀ (W : Set V),
              Eq (Cardinal.mk (Set.Elem W)) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph 1) →
                Eq (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal (SimpleGraph.induce W G)) Cardinal.aleph0)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.variants.induced_eq_aleph0_parts_ii_negation_iff_one_le
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos918.variants.induced_eq_aleph0_parts_ii_negation_iff_one_le.{u} (ω₀ : Ordinal) :
  Iff
    (Not
      (Exists fun V =>
        Exists fun G =>
          And (Eq (Cardinal.mk V) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph (HAdd.hAdd ω₀ 1)))
            (And (Eq (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal G) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph 1))
              (∀ (W : Set V),
                Eq (Cardinal.mk (Set.Elem W)) (DFunLike.coe Cardinal.aleph ω₀) →
                  Eq (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal (SimpleGraph.induce W G)) Cardinal.aleph0))))
    (LE.le 1 ω₀)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos918.variants.chromatic_shiftGraph_le_iff_card_le_iteratedTwoPow
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos918.variants.chromatic_shiftGraph_le_iff_card_le_iteratedTwoPow.{u} (r : Nat) (α : Type u) [LinearOrder α]
  {μ : Cardinal} (hμ : LE.le Cardinal.aleph0 μ) :
  Iff (LE.le (SimpleGraph.chromaticCardinal (Erdos918.ShiftGraph r α)) μ)
    (LE.le (Cardinal.mk α) (Erdos918.iteratedTwoPow r μ))
